summary: supercolor-tui drops and runs a Windows.exe from Discord CDN after disabling Defender
details: The package is advertised as a terminal color library but ships a Windows dropper that fires on first use of any Color method after `from supercolor_tui import colors`. Color paint/print/__call__ methods invoke an internal _run_payload() routine that, on Windows, self-elevates via ShellExecuteW 'runas', disables Microsoft Defender (Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring, Stop-Service WinDefend/WdNisSvc/Sense/SecurityHealthService, registry writes under Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender, Add-MpPreference exclusions for %TEMP% and the dropper folder), downloads an unverified executable from https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1442967767853563904/1568919645207920720/solace.exe to %TEMP%\SolaceRuntime\solace.exe, and launches it detached. The Defender tampering, privilege escalation, and remote binary execution are wholly unrelated to the stated terminal-coloring purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
